name: Goblin Warrior
tactics: Goblin warriors would rather fight at range, using skirmish to deal more damage with their javelins. In melee combat, they use goblin tactics to maneuver into flanking positions. Once bloodied (or once they’ve seen several of their comrades cut down), warriors tend to flee and leave allies to fend for themselves.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

traits.name: Great Position
traits.details: If, on its turn, the goblin ends its move at least 4 squares away from its starting point, it deals 1d6 extra damage on its ranged attacks until the start of its next turn.

effect.description: The goblin moves up to half its speed. At any point during that movement, it makes one ranged attack without provoking opportunity attacks.

powers.name: Goblin Tactics
powers.trigger: The goblin is missed by an attack.
